decision.summary: Write failing behavior tests then implement bounded validation and execute realized OTP tests in isolated workspace.
alternatives: Reproduce falsifiers and repair effect boundary
assumptions: User authorizes completing and admitting existing EVs; evidence requirements remain in force.
counterevidence: Existing happy-path tests miss supplied verdict forgery, replay and instability races.
decision.forecast: Falsifiers fail on base and pass after bounded repairs; runtime IAM and formal refinement remain separate obligations.
decision.falsifier: Any outsider vote, negative debit, forged or stale proposal applies successfully.
acceptance: Negative tests observed failing on base
Bounded unit and OTP actor regressions pass on immutable candidate
Positive sovereign voting and valid evolution flows retained
Parent independent review before integration or task completion
decision.rollback: Preserve failed receipts and immutable work. Do not rewrite shared journal/cycle history or replace runtime without its own checked fence and recovery path.
decision.budget: Existing realized tools only; no package downloads or paid inference. Two build jobs, two BEAM schedulers per probe, bounded subprocess timeouts; stage-specific execution ceilings recorded with receipts.
decision.reviewer: Parent independent reviewer; implementer is not sovereign admission authority.
residuals: Same-UID host mutation remains outside cooperative fences.
Historical broken chain remains evidence; it cannot be rewritten into a pass.
A complete source inventory alone does not establish runtime conformance.
Two source patches occurred after HOLD due to non-short-circuit tool batch; retained as process incident; no runtime mutation.
